qualified_semantics: maximum leaf N is evaluated from NMAXLV_TB at DVS
WOFOST81 N stress kernel determines the leaf-ageing stress index and RFRGRL
NSLLV_TB is evaluated at that stress index
combined WOFOST81 leaf death is max(DSLV, DALV), not a sum

youngest SLA is recomputed consistently when corrected GLAIEX becomes sink-limiting
outside the juvenile window GLAIEX is unchanged
when N stress is inactive, NSLLV and RFRGRL default to 1 while WOFOST81 ageing remains active
invalid leaf cohort shape is rejected
